blind.description: No text or labels can be read in any of the images. The model is a stylized architectural pillar or pedestal featuring an ocean/sea motif. It consists of a flat square top platform, a flared capital adorned with curling wave volutes and a stout three-pronged trident in relief, a vertical shaft carved with upward-curling wave crests wrapping around it, and a stepped square plinth base decorated with wave moulding. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. There are no hovering unattached pieces and no melted or distorted geometry. It stands on its own integrated square base, sitting completely flat on the floor. The finish resembles hand-painted glazed ceramic or stone in pale seafoam green/pearl white with deep aquatic teal/turquoise in the recessed reliefs. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (Tile C), it appears as a flat square platform in pale seafoam green / off-white, with the curved wave volutes of the capital slightly protruding past each of the four corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: The pillar stands approximately 9 to 9.5 feet tall, roughly 1.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure (which reaches just below the flared capital). Its square base and top platform are about 3.5 to 4 feet across, approximately three times the diameter of the figure's cylinder.
